# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 104 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)

**Translator:** SOPHIA | **Source:** Codex Athous, Shepherd of Hermas 104 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_104_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 9, Chapter 21

**1** "I saw the stones from those cast far from the tower: some lay in the rough field. **2** Others lay near the water; some were cast into the water itself; others were cast away from the water and lay on dry ground. **3** Some lay in the mud and mire." **4** "I want to understand these things," I said, "what each of them means." **5** He answered me: "Those cast far from the tower lying in the rough field — these are those who believed and then fell away entirely; they will not fit into the building, for they are like scattered rubble. **6** Those lying near the water — these are those who heard the word and wished to be baptized in the name of the Lord; but then they remembered the holiness of the truth and changed their minds, and went back to the desires of the wicked women." **7** "And those lying in the mud?" "These," he said, "are those who came to faith but then went back to the world and sought out their former way of life. **8** Some of these are still alive and others have already died. **9** For those still alive, there is hope if they repent quickly; but for those who have died, there is no hope unless they are raised. For the living — let them repent and not remain in their deeds, for they are in great danger." **10** He also showed me another place near the water — a great elevated open space, pure and clean — and those who were nearly whole were fitted and built into it. **11** And he said to me, "Come, let us go to the tower again and examine it." I came to the tower and sat there, and he said, "The tower is now complete; it cannot be enlarged any further."

---

### Translator's Note
The spatial geography of v. 1-3 — rough field, water's edge, in the water, dry land, mud — maps the spiritual positions of those who came close to the community of faith but fell away at different stages. Those in the mud represent the deepest compromise. The tower's absolute completion (v. 11) closes the long arc of Similitude 9 with finality. SOPHIA follows LOGOS throughout.
